_doc: COMPLETION PASS 13 — the ONE datum the attestation faculty cannot derive structurally. A documentation author marks status in a frontmatter block-sequence ENUM (MDN `status:` = deprecated/experimental/non-standard; the attestation faculty DISCOVERS that enum by SHAPE, never by name). But which enum VALUE means PROHIBITION ('no longer use this') is not a structural fact — every value renders an invariant, subject-varying banner, so structure alone cannot tell the deprecation banner from the experimental one (the measured PASS 11/12 wall). That single choice lives here as DATA, exactly as sources.json carries the doc sources. No banner text, no site, no element, no English — only the author's own enum value(s) that denote prohibition. Language expansion adds its markers' values here (Rust `deprecated`, Python `deprecated`).
